subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult woman performer shown in all views of <Picture 1>; all views are the same person, not multiple performers. Preserve her East Asian facial features and body proportions, dark hair loosely tied back with soft face-framing strands, natural warm makeup, cream/light-beige fine-knit short-sleeve crewneck sweater, matching light-beige knee-length pencil skirt with a small back slit, and nude pointed-toe pumps.
<Subject 2> is the cramped old dormitory interior shown in <Picture 2>: distressed pale green-gray plaster walls, metal-framed bunk beds with rumpled gray bedding and clothes hung over the rails, a worn wooden table with bottles and a folded blanket, a daylight window, radiator, kettle, and unreadable background signage/text. Keep this as the single assigned environment.
<Audio 1> is the supplied recognizable vocal reference for <Subject 1>'s performance; it governs her singing mouth articulation, pauses and breathing.

summary:
A single continuous 10.125-second performance shot: <Subject 1> sings inside <Subject 2>, matching <Audio 1> with natural mouth articulation and reference-led pauses and breathing, while the camera physically orbits about 20 degrees to her left. It opens in a frontal close head-and-shoulder composition with performance space, and ends in a close head-and-shoulder view from her front-left at roughly 30 degrees; no cut, no added text or graphics.

retention_analysis:
All views in <Picture 1> define one consistent performer; retain her identity, proportions, hairstyle, cream knit top, light-beige skirt and nude heels. Place her only within the dormitory environment of <Picture 2>, preserving the bunk beds, window, radiator, table clutter and weathered walls. Keep her performance locked to <Audio 1>: sing only when the recognizable vocal is present, with pauses and breathing following the reference. Preserve the approved one-take movement as an actual leftward orbit, not a stationary pan, and keep the declared close framing from frontal opening to front-left ending. Do not add people, cuts, locations, readable text or extra audio.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] One continuous performance take of approximately 10.125 seconds. The frame opens in a frontal close shot of <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>, head and shoulders, with space left on her singing side; she is placed inside <Subject 2> from <Picture 2>, where the weathered dormitory depth remains legible behind her—metal bunk beds and hanging clothes to one side, pale-green patchy walls, a daylight window, radiator, table with bottles and a kettle, with any background notices or paper labels remaining unreadable. She sings with an invested but controlled musical performance: natural mouth articulation synchronized only to the recognizable vocal in <Audio 1>, pauses and breathing following the reference, while subtle head and shoulder movement and a small, clear gesture from her free hand remain visible without breaking the close head-and-shoulder crop. The camera makes a physical leftward orbit around her of about 20 degrees, keeping the current close crop and allowing her to drift naturally off center while the background shows clear but restrained local parallax; this is a true moving-camera orbit, not an in-place pan. The leftward arc continues through the final frame, ending in a close head-and-shoulder composition from her front-left at roughly 30 degrees. Preserve her identity, body proportions, cream knit top, light-beige skirt, nude shoes, and the dormitory lighting and environment consistently. Every frame stays free of added subtitles, captions, lyrics, watermarks and graphic overlays. Do not transcribe writing visible in the reference backgrounds.
